domain: Wet-Lab Research Automation / Molecular Biology & NGS Automation

occupations: Medical and Clinical Laboratory Technologists and Technicians (BLS SOC 29-2010, >340,000 workers)
Life Scientists, All Other (BLS SOC 19-1099, >35,000 workers)

context: In high-throughput genomic sequencing (NGS) library construction, clinical molecular diagnostics (e.g. viral RNA/DNA extraction), and solid-phase reversible immobilization (SPRI) magnetic bead cleanup protocols, reaction mixtures held in chilled 96-well skirted PCR cooler racks are routinely transferred onto high-gradient neodymium magnetic separation stands to immobilize magnetic beads along the well walls. A sliding mechanical lock bar is engaged over the skirt rim to rigidly retain the rack against strong magnetic pull-down forces, ensuring uniform bead ring pelleting and preventing plate displacement during automated washing steps.
instruction: Transfer the 96-well PCR cooler rack onto the magnetic separation stand and engage the slide lock bar.
setup: A benchtop workstation with a silicone cleanroom staging mat at X=0.260 m, Y=0.200 m holding a chilled cobalt blue 96-well skirted PCR cooler rack (127.8 x 85.5 x 28.0 mm, 110 g). At X=0.280 m, Y=-0.040 m sits a precision anodized aluminum 96-well neodymium magnetic bead separation stand (140 x 105 x 35 mm) with recessed registration nest and a safety-orange mechanical sliding lock bar (prismatic slider along Y, travel 20 mm).
reset: The PCR cooler rack is initialized flush on the staging mat at (0.260, 0.200, 0.7665). The magnetic stand slide lock bar is initialized fully retracted at q=0.0 mm. Both robot arms initialize at standard park configurations.
fidelity: 100% genuine dynamic contact bodies via PhysX. Zero synthetic teleportation or write_root_pose_to_sim calls. Authentic ANSI/SLAS 1-2004 96-well microplate footprint and standard laboratory apparatus dimensions.

apparatus.cooler_rack: Chilled 96-well skirted polypropylene PCR cooler rack (127.8 x 85.5 x 28.0 mm, ANSI/SLAS standard, 110 g)
apparatus.magnetic_stand: Anodized aluminum benchtop 96-well magnetic bead separation stand (140 x 105 x 35 mm) with recessed registration nest and 96 nickel-plated neodymium ring magnet posts
apparatus.slider_lock: Prismatic sliding retaining lock bar along Y (travel 20 mm, minimum engagement threshold 8.0 mm)

rubric.description: Rack resting untouched on bench staging mat
Rack lifted and transferring toward magnetic stand
Rack seated flush in magnetic registration nest (horizontal error <= 20 mm, vertical flush <= 18 mm), lock bar advancing toward engagement (0.0 to 8.0 mm)
Rack seated and lock bar fully engaged (>=8.0 mm travel), hands retracted clear (>50 mm) for 20-step (1.0 s) continuous stillness hold

scoring.instantaneous_compliance: Zero permanent positive stage latching. All criteria evaluated from live physical state at each simulation step; unseating rack or retracting lock bar immediately revokes score and resets dwell to 0.
